text:
Avery: OK holiday logistics q: who wants to join a tiny Desk Ornament Secret Exchange? Leave one on your desk labeled "swap" and pick one up. Nothing fancy, 5-10 bucks vibe. Also low-key wrapping paper swap in the laundry bin? :ornament:
Samir: Love this. I have a box of random tiny ornaments from travels. Also yes to wrapping paper swap  I hoard shiny scraps.
Lina: Count me in! I will add a hand-painted mini ornament. Also quick poll: should we do a 15-min office karaoke at 4pm Friday (very optional)? React :one: for yes, :two: for nah.
Ben: Reacted :one: but my repertoire is strictly "All I Want for Christmas Is You" and questionable key choices.
Avery: Karaoke + ornament swap it is. I'll post a tiny sign with rules: take one ornament, leave one, and if you take wrapping paper, please leave a note about how many sheets you grabbed.
Samir: Also proposing a small prize for most creative ornament (voted by applause at karaoke). Prize: $10 coffee card.
Lina: Ooh leaderboard energy. If you need accessories for karaoke, I can bring a glittery scarf and a tiny Santa hat.
wrapping-bot: Reminder scheduled: Fri 15:50 in #random \u2014 "Desk Ornament Swap + 4pm Tiny Karaoke (bring your best cheesy ballad)" :white_check_mark:
Ben: I'll DJ a 10-song shortlist. Also sign-up sheet for 30s slots? We can do a signup in the kitchen on sticky notes.
Avery: Posting sticky sign-up now. If you want to join but are remote, record a 30s video and we'll play it during the break. Happy holidays and bracing for terrible singing. :microphone: :tada:
